title: 6 April 1963: Live: Pavilion Gardens Ballroom, Buxton
content:
The Beatles performed at this venue, in St John’s Road, Buxton, Derbyshire on two occasions. The second time was on 19 October 1963.

Page last updated: 25 January 2024

Also on this day...

  • 2019: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Tokyo Dome City Hall, Tokyo
  • 2002: Paul McCartney live: MGM Grand Garden Arena, Las Vegas
  • 1977: The Beatles lose legal action to prevent Star-Club tapes release
  • 1974: John Lennon, Paul McCartney, and Ringo Starr meet in Santa Monica
  • 1973: Interview: John Lennon and Yoko Ono for Weekend World
  • 1971: Recording: Long Haired Lady by Paul and Linda McCartney
  • 1967: Mixing: Sgt Pepper crossfades, Good Morning Good Morning
  • 1967: Paul McCartney and Jane Asher holiday in Denver
  • 1966: Recording: Tomorrow Never Knows
  • 1965: UK EP release: Beatles For Sale
  • 1965: Filming: Help!
  • 1964: Filming: A Hard Day’s Night
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Tower Ballroom, New Brighton, Wallasey
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Top Ten Club, Hamburg
